# ---- german ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the german merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_german_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_north_german }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_german_north_german
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_south_german }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_german_south_german
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the german merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_german_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_german_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_german_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_german_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_german_progress
	multiply = 100
}

}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_yugoslav_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_yugoslav_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- czechoslovak ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the czechoslovak merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_czech }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_czech
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_slovak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_slovak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_czech }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_czech
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_slovak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_slovak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_sorb }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_sorb
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the czechoslovak merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_czechoslovak_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_czechoslovak_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_czechoslovak_progress
	multiply = 100
}

				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_anglo_canadian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_australian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_dixie ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_british }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_british
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_yankee }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_yankee
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_cm_american }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_cm_american
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_anglo_canadian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_anglo_canadian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_anglo_canadian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_australian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_australian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_australian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_scottish }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_scottish
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_dixie ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_dixie }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_dixie
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_afro_american }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_anglophone_afro_american
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the anglophone merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_anglophone_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_anglophone_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_anglophone_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_anglophone_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_anglophone_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- brazilian ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the brazilian merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_brazilian_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_nordestino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_nordestino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_paulista }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_paulista
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
			}
			if = {

				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_amazonic
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {

				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
			}

				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_sulista
			}
			else = {

			}
		}
	}
}

			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_ecuadorian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_ecuadorian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_colombian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_colombian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_venezuelan }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_venezuelan
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_ecuadorian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_gran_colombian_ecuadorian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the gran_colombian merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_gran_colombian_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_gran_colombian_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_gran_colombian_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- chinese ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the chinese merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_chinese_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_yue ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_min ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_yue ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_chinese_yue }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_chinese_yue
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_min ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_chinese_min }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_chinese_min
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_chinese_hakka }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_chinese_hakka
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkish }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkish
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkmen }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkmen
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the oghuz_turkic merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- hindustani ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the hindustani merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_hindustani_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_avadhi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_avadhi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bundeli }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bundeli
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_chhattisgarhi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_chhattisgarhi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_filipino_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_filipino_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_filipino_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_filipino_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_filipino_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- nguni ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the nguni merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_nguni_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_nguni_nguni }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_nguni_nguni
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_nguni_zulu }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_nguni_zulu
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_nguni_xhosa }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_nguni_xhosa
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kazak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_tatar ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kirgiz ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_bashkir ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uighur ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_uzbek }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_uzbek
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kazak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_kazak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_kazak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_tatar ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_tatar }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_tatar
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kirgiz ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_kirgiz }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_kirgiz
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_bashkir ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_bashkir }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_bashkir
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uighur ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_uighur }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_uighur
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the pan_turkic merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_pan_turkic_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_pan_turkic_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_pan_turkic_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- pan_malay ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the pan_malay merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_pan_malay_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_pan_malay_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1

			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}
